notes.title: Version 0.3.8
notes.notes: [p]New Update for "Fishing Grind" 0.3.8[/p][p]Hey everyone! Here is a small update for you all. I have been busy with life stuff, so the update is not very big. However, I am now on my retention arc and so updates might be more frequent. In all seriousness though, I did a lot of code reworking in this update to hopefully make development easier and bugs less common. Part two of the update is now in development and might come out within the next 8 months.[/p][p][/p][p][b]Patch Notes[/b][/p][p][/p][p][b]New Content[/b][/p][list][*][p]Added Localization[/p][/*][*][p]Added a few new Tier 2 quests[/p][/*][*][p]Added Sunglasses[/p][/*][*][p]Added Bucket Hat[/p][/*][*][p]Added Emotes[/p][/*][*][p]Added Blood effects when the player shoots enemies[/p][/*][*][p]Added short intro cutscene to Market[/p][p][/p][/*][/list][p][b]Changes[/b][/p][list][*][p]Fixed a bug that locked up the player's control when being attacked by the Hunter[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed a bug that made it impossible to use fish traps[/p][/*][*][p]Overhaled save system[/p][/*][*][p]Lowered sonar range[/p][/*][*][p]Changed the "hide HUD" button to F8[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed a bug where the player could climb on some rocks and go out of bounds in Yellowstone[/p][/*][*][p]Removed volumetric clouds and replaced them with clouds that have better performance[/p][/*][*][p]Made it so players can move while using the quick menu[/p][p][/p][/*][/list][p][b]Localization[/b][/p][p]Added German and Russian languages[/p][p][/p][p][b]Emotes[/b][/p][p]Press the "1" and "2" keys to preform emotes.[/p][p][/p][p][b]Known Bugs[/b][/p][list][*][p]Can move in tutorial intro.[/p][/*][*][p]Fishing Rod invisible in tutorial intro.[/p][/*][*][p]Cougar sometimes instantly goes back and kills player after attacking.[/p][/*][*][p]Bear sometimes gets stuck while running.[/p][p][/p][/*][/list][p]If you find any bugs it would be really helpful if you reported them in our discord server or in community discussions![/p]

notes.title: Version 0.3.7
notes.notes:
Small update to fix some bugs and add a little content!

@Fisherman New Update for "Fishing Grind" 0.3.7

[b]Patch Notes[/b]

[b]New Content[/b]
[list]
[*] Added four new clothing skins that can be unlocked in game
[*] You can now press the "F1" key to hide the HUD
[*] Added ability to collect mushrooms in Oregon
[*] Added a bunch of new missions
[/list]

[b]Changes[/b]
[list]
[*] Fixed weird light bugs in Yellowstone
[*] Fixed a bug that made it so the Hunter couldn't damage the player with his gun
[*] Lowered the price per pound for the cutthroat trout to $6 (was $12)
[*] Lowered the price per pound for the Suwannee bass to $12 (was $23)
[*] Lowered the price per pound for the Common Carp to $2 (was $3)
[*] Lowered the price per pound for the Northern Pike to $3 (was $11)
[*] Fixed quest text clipping in the market
[*] Doubled sonar tracking distance
[*] Fixed some ice fishing bugs
[*] Made it so sonar doesn't beep when near dead threats
[*] Crankbait Shiny now increases the chance of catching Lingcod in Alaska (5%)
[*] Temporarily disabled the Day/Night cycle.
[/list]

If you find any bugs it would be really helpful if you reported them in our discord server or in community discussions!

notes.title: Update 0.3.6
notes.notes:
News! I have started working on Localization! However, there is a large amount of text in the game, so it's going to be a while before it's actually added. The first two languages introduced will be Russian and German. Ice fishing is playable but there are still a lot of bugs and there is a lot of polish that will still be done. Working to roll out those updates soon!

New Update for "Fishing Grind" 0.3.6

[b]Patch Notes[/b]

[b]New Content[/b]
[list]
[*] Added North Dakota map
[*] Added New fish
[*] Added Ice Auger
[*] Added Ice Fishing
[*] Added Day/Night cycle
[*] Added enemy health scaling
[*] Added pelt quality mechanic
[*] Added ability to turn off dynamic resolution in settings
[*] Added new voice lines for Lenny when you get quests from him
[*] Added shotgun
[*] Added quest tiers
[*] Added PVP
[/list]

[b]Changes[/b]
[list]
[*] Improved performance on the Yellowstone and Oregon maps.
[*] Lowered medium fish trap price to $200
[*] Made deer AI slightly better by increasing the player detection radius
[*] Lowered bear health to 100 (was 200)
[*] Lowered cougar health to 80 (was 100)
[*] Made it so guns have limited range
[*] Added gun recoil animations and camera shake.
[*] Added quest description graphic when in Lenny's quest menu
[*] Made trap fish grabbing animation 25% faster
[/list]

[b]Enemy Health Scaling[/b]
Some enemies now have health scaling that depends on the number of players in the current match. This just means that when you have more people in a game, it will be harder to take down threats.

[b]Pelt Quality[/b]
Animal hide/pelts now have a quality level. The more you shoot the animal, the more the quality goes down, which makes the value go down. Some guns tatter the pelts more then others.

[b]Ice Fishing[/b]
In the new North Dakota map, you can drill holes in ice with the ice auger. If you stand near these ice holes and use your fishing rod you are able to ice fish. Ice fishing works similarly to regular fishing except the player

[b]New Fish[/b]
[list]
[*] Walleye
[*] Northern Pike
[*] Suwannee Bass
[*] Cutthrout Trout
[*] Green Sunfish
[*] White Bass
[*] Yellow Perch
[*] Common Carp
[/list]

[b]Shotgun[/b]
Epic

[b]PVP[/b]
There is a new toggle in the settings menu that lets you shoot your friends.

If you find any bugs it would be really helpful if you reported them in our discord server or in community discussions!

notes.title: Update 0.3.4
notes.notes:
[b][h2]Announcement[/h2][/b]
We are releasing a supporter pack! We don't feel like the game is in a state where we can justify actual DLCs, but we have had a few people express interest in supporting Fishing Grind financially. The pack comes with a clothing set, some items, and a prompt that lets you get your name in the credits if you are one of the first 100 to buy the pack! Sorry about the ice fishing delay, we have had some priority changes, but we plan to get it out as soon as possible! If you have any questions let us know in the comments of this post!

New Update for "Fishing Grind" 0.3.4

[b]Patch Notes[/b]

[b]New Content[/b]
[list]
[*] Added jumping
[*] Added sound effect when fish bites bobber
[*] Added English subtitles
[*] Added New quests
[*] Added sounds to the Market area
[/list]

[b]Changes[/b]
[list]
[*] Increased all Florida fish prices except for Alligator Gar
[*] Updated quest system
[*] Made many animation changes to make the player more dynamic
[*] Changed rarity of silver salmon to rare
[*] Changed rarity of bowfin to rare
[*] Made it so players can listen to Lookout tower tape multiple times
[/list]

[b]Bug Fixes[/b]
Fixed a bug that made the bobber splash particles flip out

[b]Updated Quest System[/b]
You can now visit Lenny and trade quests in or out. You can carry up to four quests at a time. (If you have a save file from before this update then you may have up to seven quests equipped, this change won't effect you until you complete these quests or if you trade them out for other ones).

If you find any bugs it would be really helpful if you reported them in our discord server or in community discussions!

notes.title: Fishing Grind - The Yellowstone Update
notes.notes:
[h1][b]Announcement[/b][/h1]
Before you read the patch notes, I would like to get your attention for an important announcement. Our plans have changed, and we have decided to turn the ice fishing DLC into a [b]FREE[/b] update! We realize the game still needs a lot of work. We want to keep improving it, but we are a small development team, and we all have our own busy lives, so it is going to take time. Thank you for all the support so far!

- LAGI Games

[b]Yellowstone[/b]
Explore the stunning Wyoming landscape and catch the new Flathead Catfish!

[b]Fish Traps[/b]
Two new fish traps have been added. You can place them almost anywhere near hotspots and over time they will passively trap fish, you can then claim the trapped fish and sell them at the truck.

[b]Handheld Sonar Rework[/b]
In 0.3 handheld sonar worked by shooting a beam in the direction the player is looking, and if it detected any threats it would beep. We decided to experiment and change it to a device that beeps if it detects anything within a radius. You can also clip it to your belt so you can fish and use it at the same time.

notes.title: Fishing Grind Demo Releasing October 10th at 7:00am!
notes.notes:
Some of our followers may have noticed that the release date for Fishing Grind has changed from October 22nd to October 31st. The reason for this change was because the game is not in a state where we feel there is enough content to justify such an early access release. But instead of making you wait longer; we have decided to release a demo that shows off a little bit of what Fishing Grind is about! This demo isn't perfect, and there are a fair number of bugs, but we want to incorporate the community early on in development. [b]This demo will be updated through October 18th.[/b]

Keep in mind that our team is very small, but we are still trying to make the best game possible!

- LAGI Games
